product_overview: Lama Ecommerce (AvioraWear) is a production-ready e-commerce platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase that provides a public storefront, customer account area, and full-featured admin panel for product, order, and user management.
core_goals: Provide a fast, accessible storefront for browsing and purchasing products with robust filtering and search.
Offer secure authentication and role-based authorization for customers and administrators.
Enable complete cart-to-order lifecycle with transactional order creation, shipping, and payment readiness.
Deliver an admin interface for managing products, orders, users, analytics, and website content.
Maintain strong security, validation, and maintainability using layered architecture and best practices.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to sign in with email and password using Supabase Auth and redirect based on role.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Toggle password visibility -> Click Login button to submit -> See success toast on successful login -> Redirect to / or /admin based on role
Navigate to /auth/login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: User Signup
features.description: Allow new users to register with name, email, and password and receive validation feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/signup -> Fill name input field -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Confirm password field -> See password strength indicator -> Click Sign up button to submit -> See success message on successful signup -> Redirect to / or onboarding

Navigate to /auth/signup -> Fill name input field -> Fill email input field with invalid email -> Fill password input field -> Confirm password field mismatched -> Click Sign up button to submit -> See error message on validation failure

features.name: Product Browsing
features.description: Browse, filter, sort, and search products on the public products listing to find items.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> View product grid/list -> Select category filter -> Select color filter -> Select size filter -> Adjust price range slider -> Sort products by price -> Click on product to view details -> Navigate to /products/[slug]
Navigate to /products -> Fill search input with query -> Click Search -> See 'no results' message when no products match -> Adjust filters or clear search

features.name: Product Details
features.description: View complete product information including images, variants, availability, reviews, and related products.
user_flows: Navigate to /products/[slug] -> View product images gallery -> Select product variant (color, size, material) -> View product price and availability -> Add product to cart -> See cart updated toast -> Navigate to /cart
Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Select product variant that is out of stock -> See out-of-stock message -> Prevent Add product to cart action

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: Manage cart items for guests and authenticated users including quantity updates, removal, and proceeding to checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /cart -> View cart items -> Update item quantity -> See cart subtotal update -> Select shipping zone -> Proceed to checkout
Navigate to /cart -> Update item quantity above available stock -> See validation error message preventing update

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Save favorite products to a wishlist and move wishlist items into the cart; adding requires authentication.
user_flows: Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Click Add product to wishlist -> If authenticated: See wishlist updated toast -> Navigate to /wishlist -> View wishlist items -> Click Add wishlist item to cart -> Navigate to /cart
Navigate to /products/[slug] -> Click Add product to wishlist -> If not authenticated: Redirect to /auth/login -> See login prompt/message

features.name: User Profile
features.description: View and edit user profile information, addresses, and view order history in a protected profile area.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> View profile information -> Click Edit profile -> Fill name input field -> Fill email input field -> Click Save -> See success toast on profile update
Navigate to /profile -> Click Edit profile -> Fill email input field with invalid email -> Click Save -> See error message on validation failure

features.name: Order Management
features.description: Allow customers to view their order history and detailed order information including tracking and shipping.
user_flows: Navigate to /orders -> View orders list -> Filter orders by status -> Click an order -> Navigate to /order_details/[id] -> View order items and shipping information
Navigate to /orders when unauthenticated -> Redirect to /auth/login -> See login required message

features.name: Admin Dashboard
features.description: Provide admins with an overview of key metrics, recent activity, and navigation to admin sections.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> See dashboard statistics -> Click recent orders -> Navigate to /admin/orders -> Click recent users -> Navigate to /admin/users
Navigate to /admin as non-admin -> See access denied or redirect to / -> See message indicating insufficient permissions

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Create, edit, and manage products, variants, images, categories, and publish status in the admin panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/products -> Click Create new product -> Navigate to /admin/products/create -> Fill product form fields -> Upload product images -> Add product variants -> Click Save -> See product created success -> Redirect to /admin/products or /admin/products/[id]
Navigate to /admin/products/create -> Fill product form with missing required field -> Click Save -> See validation error message and prevent product creation

features.name: Admin Order Management
features.description: View and manage customer orders including updating status, viewing payment info, and processing refunds.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/orders -> View orders list -> Filter orders by status -> Click an order -> Navigate to /admin/orders/[id] -> Update order status -> See success message on update
Navigate to /admin/orders/[id] -> Attempt to update order to invalid status -> See error message preventing status update
